title: Run a beta or pilot with real users
summary: Before opening to everyone, let a small group use the real product for real tasks. A beta finds the problems testing cannot and builds confidence for the full launch.

beginner: Decide what you want to learn from the beta and what would make you ready to launch more widely.
Choose a small group of real users who represent your main audience, including some who may struggle.
Tell them what to expect, how to give feedback and how to get help.
Watch the data and feedback closely, and talk to some users directly.
Fix the most important problems quickly and tell users what changed.
At the end, decide: go wider, run longer or change direction.
intermediate: Set beta goals and exit criteria.
Recruit a representative group and set up feedback and support routes.
Monitor data, feedback and support tickets, and fix the top issues.
Make a documented go or no-go decision.
experienced: Use staged rollout with feature flags to widen access gradually.
Compare beta users with a control group where possible.
Agree exit criteria with stakeholders before the beta starts.
Use beta evidence to sharpen positioning and launch messages.

canDelegateTo.task: Recruit beta users and run follow-up interviews
Monitor beta metrics against the exit criteria
Set up feature flags or a separate beta environment

toolExamples.amplitude: Create a cohort of beta users and compare their behaviour with others.
toolExamples.ga4: Add a user property for beta users so you can filter reports.
toolExamples.jira: Create a beta feedback board and triage it daily.
toolExamples.notion: Keep a beta log of issues, fixes and what you told users.

definitionOfDone: Beta goals and exit criteria agreed
pitfalls: Recruiting only friendly or expert users
No clear exit criteria, so the beta never ends
Collecting feedback but not acting on it

leaderView.good: A small group uses the real product for real tasks before it opens to everyone.
ask: What did the beta teach us, and what did we change?
signs: The beta is a marketing exercise.
There are no criteria for moving from beta to full launch.
